title: Project Enablement Manager – DDA Insights and Analytics

titleByLocale.it: Project Enablement Manager – Insight e Analisi DDA
titleByLocale.en: Project Enablement Manager – DDA Insights and Analytics
titleByLocale.de: Project Enablement Manager – DDA Insights and Analytics
titleByLocale.fr: Project Enablement Manager – DDA Insights and Analytics

descriptionByLocale.it:
At Roche you can show up as yourself, embraced for the unique qualities you bring. Our culture encourages personal expression, open dialogue, and genuine connections, where you are valued, accepted and respected for who you are, allowing you to thrive both personally and professionally. This is how we aim to prevent, stop and cure diseases and ensure everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Join Roche, where every voice matters. The Position Relocation benefits are not available for this job posting. Position Overview: As Project Enablement Manager, you will be part of an in-house project management pool, reporting to the Chapter Lead Project Enablement, and accountable for delivering project services and deliverables within your area of expertise, supporting DDA Insights and Analytics initiatives through structured execution, cross-functional coordination, and transparent reporting to ensure timely delivery and alignment with organizational priorities. The Opportunity:
• Oversee end-to-end project and program management across multiple Insights and Analytics initiatives, ensuring clear definition, sequencing, tracking, and achievement of objectives, milestones, and success criteria.
• Drive execution by coordinating cross-functional teams (product owners, data scientists, engineers, and business stakeholders), ensuring alignment across workstreams and program priorities.
• Maintain and evolve integrated dashboards, timelines, and reporting frameworks to provide visibility into progress, risks, dependencies, and overall program health.
• Proactively manage risks, issues, and interdependencies across initiatives, ensuring timely escalation and resolution to support on-time delivery and continuity across project phases.
• Enable scalable and consistent delivery by establishing governance models and execution frameworks and facilitating stakeholder alignment through structured working sessions, clear communication, and effective decision tracking. Who you are:
• Apply and tailor methodologies, tools, and techniques (Agile, Waterfall, Hybrid, Design Thinking, and Lean) to solve complex business problems, including leading pre-project phases and developing qualitative and quantitative business cases.
• Demonstrate strong project and program management expertise, including facilitation of sprints, stakeholder workshops, and cross-functional collaboration, with the ability to manage ambiguity and calculated risks.
• Operate as an enterprise and systems thinker, identifying interdependencies, risks, and synergies across projects and portfolios while ensuring alignment with broader organizational objectives.
• Leverage data-driven decision-making through performance measurement, gap analysis, and insights generation, maintaining clear documentation, reporting standards, and best practices for transparency and continuity.
• Bring a bachelor’s degree in business or related fields with 5–7 years of experience, strong stakeholder management and communication skills, experience in complex environments, and familiarity with organizational change management and cross-functional delivery models. Please note: Resumes must be submitted in English, as our interview panel may include participants from outside your local country. #LI-DC1 Who we are A healthier future drives us to innovate. Together, more than 100’000 employees across the globe are dedicated to advance science, ensuring everyone has access to healthcare today and for generations to come. Our efforts result in more than 26 million people treated with our medicines and over 30 billion tests conducted using our Diagnostics products. We empower each other to explore new possibilities, foster creativity, and keep our ambitions high, so we can deliver life-changing healthcare solutions that make a global impact. Let’s build a healthier future, together. Roche is an Equal Opportunity Employer.
